_comment: HDFC's wallet. Written from 32 real messages, Oct 2025 onward.
DOUBLE-COUNT WARNING. A wallet has two kinds of movement:
load  -- money entering the wallet from a bank or card. NOT income.
spend -- money leaving the wallet. This is the real expense.
Counting a load as income inflates both sides of the books. The load is
given a merchant ('PayZapp Wallet') precisely so a consumer can attach an
'always: transfer' rule to it, the same treatment as an ICICI card bill.
Checked against this owner's data: none of the 5 wallet loads matched an
HDFC debit of the same amount within 24h, so the funding side is not in
the SMS corpus. Re-check if a bank profile is added later.
A wallet SPEND names no merchant at all -- 'Rs.60 debited from your PayZapp
Wallet on ...' and nothing more. Leaving payee null is the honest result:
these stay `pending` for manual categorization rather than being filed
under a merchant we never actually learned.
